claim: Meta's Q2 2026 revenue was the first quarterly result above $60 billion.
summary: Insufficient evidence to verify Meta's Q2 2026 revenue or whether it was the first quarter above $60 billion, because Q2 2026 postdates the knowledge cutoff.

sub_claims.text: Meta's Q2 2026 revenue was above $60 billion.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before end and reporting of Q2 2026 (April-June 2026), so Q2 2026 revenue value cannot be established from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: No quarterly result before Q2 2026 was above $60 billion, making Q2 2026 the first such quarter.
sub_claims.note: Cannot establish full history of all Meta quarterly revenues through Q2 2026 and that none before Q2 2026 exceeded $60 billion, as Q2 2026 postdates knowledge cutoff.
